name: Kekkon Yubiwa Monogatari VR
source:
A story about an average high school student named Satou, who receives an unexpected email from Hime, the mysterious girl living next door, that leads to the adventure of a lifetime.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/692360]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个名叫佐藤的普通高中生，收到了一封来自隔壁神秘女孩姬的意外电子邮件，从而开启了一生的冒险。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/692360]Steam[/url]]
